jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We've already landed in some of the most influential organizations on the planet from nimble startups to Fortune 100 giants. Over 400+ customers trust us to power their contract workflows, and our AI Contract Repository and Intelligence products are becoming mission-critical for legal and procurement teams at scale.

As we scale, we need commercially sharp Account Managers who can run a high-velocity book of business, protecting and growing revenue without losing quality or pace. As a Mid-Market Account Manager, you'll be responsible for renewals, upsells, and expansion. You'll move fast, know where to spend your time based on health signals, renewal timing, and upsell potential, and run repeatable commercial motions that compound over time. This is a quota-carrying role with direct impact on Ivo's revenue from day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Own Your Book**
-----------------

* Manage a portfolio of 75-100 mid-market accounts and own retention and revenue growth while consistently meeting or exceeding expansion targets.
* Develop strong stakeholder management strategies by identifying, mapping and cultivating relationships across multiple functions and levels within customer accounts to mitigate risk, increase stickiness, and uncover growth opportunities.
* Run tight, proactive renewal cycles - starting conversations early, identifying risk before it becomes churn, and closing on time.
* Prioritize your book based on health signals, renewal timing, and upsell potential — and drive the right conversations.

**Grow Revenue**
----------------

* Identify and close upsell and expansion opportunities across your accounts including new products and expanded use cases.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline hygiene in CRM in partnership with your manager, leadership and RevOps.

**Partner Cross-Functionally**
------------------------------

* Work closely with Customer Success Managers, Solutions Engineers, Legal Engineers and Implementation leads to ensure seamless coordination between value delivery and commercial strategy.
* Facilitate case studies, reference programs, and marketing initiatives helping Ivo win new business.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* **3+ years** of account management or sales experience in B2B SaaS, with a consistent track record in quota-carrying roles.
* **Proven track record** of managing and growing large book of accounts simultaneously and know how to triage, prioritize, and run repeatable motions at pace.
* **Account planning and multi-threading** — you can assess your book, identify whitespace, map key contacts across teams, and orchestrate deals with multiple stakeholders.
* **Strong commercial acumen** comfortable navigating large contracts, pricing conversations and procurement processes.
* **Collaborative operator** you know how to align internal teams (CS, Product, Legal, Finance) around customer needs and high-stakes renewals.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in legal tech, contract management, or vertical SaaS
* Familiarity with AI/ML products and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.
* Experience with complex deals involving legal, finance, and IT buying centers.

**Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:**
-------------------------------------------

* Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.
* You have a strong internal sense of urgency. You have a bias towards doing things *today*, rather than tomorrow.
* Experience working in a startup environment is preferred but not required.
* Are excited about the adventure of building a company!

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.
* **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast
* **Health & Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.
* **Flexible Spending & Insurance:** Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.
* **401(k) Program:** Save for the future with our 401(k) program.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.
* **Unlimited PTO:** So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.

**FAQ**

* *What stage of growth is Ivo at?:* We recently raised our Series B after growing 6x in 12 months.
* *Is this a chill gig?:* Startups are very hard, especially if they’re growing fast. You’ll have a ton of responsibility, and there’s always an enormous amount of stuff to do. It’s hard work but the payoff is uncapped.

*Ivo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

The first baby boomers turn 80 this year. Over the next decade, the population most likely to need daily care will grow faster than the buildings, the staff, or the systems available to serve it.

Sage is the care intelligence platform for senior living and skilled nursing. We connect the hardware senior care runs on, including nurse call, fall management, and wander management, with software caregivers actually use. That consistent use is what produces reliable data, and reliable data is what gives operators a true picture of how their communities are running.

Sage is a collaborative team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs on a mission to reinvent senior care with a modern operating system for caregivers. Millions of people depend on this care getting better, and we move with the urgency that deserves.

**About This Role**

Sage operates with a land-and-expand motion across senior living operators. Once Sales lands a pilot, you’ll transform early wins into portfolio-wide rollouts, measurable value realization, and durable executive partnerships. You’ll refine and execute our expansion playbook, strengthen multi-level relationships, and translate the impact delivered by Product and Client Success into long-term, multi-community growth.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role that blends enterprise account management, strategic expansion, and executive relationship building. You’ll partner closely with Client Success, Product, Implementation, and Sales to ensure our operators achieve meaningful outcomes—and grow with Sage as a result.

This role requires up to 50% discretionary travel, including time onsite with partners and regular collaboration at our New York City office.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute expansion strategies that move operators from pilot deployments to multi-community rollouts, including cross-sell and add-on opportunities
* Maintain an accurate view of expansion opportunities, forecast with rigor, and deliver against quarterly revenue and retention targets
* Build and deepen relationships with C-suite and regional leaders across operators, Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), and PE-owned platforms; lead business reviews, align on strategic goals, and remove blockers
* Quantify operational and clinical value (workflow efficiency, risk reduction, care outcomes) and package insights into compelling, fact-based narratives that drive buy-in and budget approval
* Turn operator goals into clear action plans and orchestrate efforts across Implementation, Client Success, Product, Engineering, and Marketing
* Act as an executive escalation path for both Sage and operator partners; anticipate issues early and drive fast, durable resolutions
* Participate in executive meetings, conferences, and industry events to deepen relationships and unlock new growth pathways

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years in enterprise account management, sales, or business development, ideally in B2B technology
* Proven track record of driving expansion revenue through upsells, cross-sells, or broader enterprise adoption
* Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and building VP/C-suite relationships
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and consistent performance against revenue targets
* Ability to articulate product value and build compelling business cases for executive stakeholders
* High ownership, strong commercial instincts, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware-enabled technology, IoT, or integrated software and hardware solutions
* Familiarity with senior living, skilled nursing, healthcare, or other operationally complex industries
* Experience expanding accounts across multiple locations, business units, or regional teams
* Experience building repeatable expansion playbooks or scaling pilots into enterprise-wide deployments
* Familiarity with complex enterprise ownership structures, including private equity-backed businesses

**Benefits and Pay**

Our headquarters are located in New York City’s Union Square, and we value cross-team collaboration and in-person connection. We encourage participation from all team members—great ideas can come from anywhere. While we take our mission seriously, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We host offsites, outings, and team meals to stay connected as people. We offer office lunch, a fully stocked snack bar, and an in-office culture with flexibility for remote work.

We provide competitive base compensation along with stock options and performance-based commission. The expected annual base salary range for this role is **$150,000–$175,000 USD**, with an additional $150,000 in target annual commission, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to **$300,000–$325,000 USD**. Compensation within the range will depend on experience and interview performance, with the top of the band reserved for candidates whose experience and qualifications align with the senior end of the role.

We offer fully paid health and dental coverage, plus vision insurance, premium primary and urgent care memberships, online health providers, unlimited PTO (“take what you need”), seven paid holidays, and a company-wide winter break.

**EEO Statement**

Sage is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices, including hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeships. Sage bases hiring decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager , ES - Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
  
  
More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences - restaurants, events, wellness and travel - and the million-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time.

**Social Media Specialist — NA**

***Full-time · Chicago (preferred) or US remote · Reports to Brand Marketing Director***

**About the Role**
==================

We're looking for a Social Media Manager to lead organic social strategy for Groupon across our main market, North America. This is a hands-on, AI-driven role: you'll set the direction, but you'll also be in the platforms every day — building, testing, and producing with generative tools as your default.

You'll report to the Brand Marketing Director, and you'll work closely with the Social Media Manager for International on shared standards, tooling, and production, and partner with our new Creative Director on creative quality and campaign integration. The remit is organic only across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and whichever platform matters next quarter.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Strategy & direction**

* Lead the organic social strategy across North America (US) — channel mix, content pillars, posting cadence, and platform-specific approaches.
* Define what *good* looks like for our channels and translate brand strategy into social-native ideas that actually perform on each platform.
* Set quarterly priorities and a content roadmap aligned with brand campaigns, commercial moments, and platform trends.

### **Hands-on production**

* Personally produce flagship content and AI-driven experiments — you should be in the tools, not just briefing them.
* Build with generative tools (e.g. Kling, Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Runway, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) and adopt new ones as they emerge. Specific tools matter less than fluency and taste.
* Maintain a consistent weekly publishing cadence across priority channels to keep our communities active and our accounts present in the algorithm, using AI-driven production to make that volume possible without dropping the bar on quality.
* Prototype new formats and content concepts that the rest of the team can then scale into a repeatable production line.

### **Collaboration**

* Partner with the Social Media Manager for INTL on shared creative standards, AI tooling, production workflows, and the use of shared resources across the function.
* Work closely with the Creative Director on visual identity, campaign integration, and creative quality.
* Coordinate with regional market leads, PR, performance marketing, and brand to keep social aligned with the wider company narrative.

### **Performance & insight**

* Own the metrics that matter for organic social — views, reach, engagement quality, audience growth, brand-relevant signals — and translate them into clear decisions.
* Run a regular test-and-learn cadence; kill what underperforms quickly; double down on what works.
* Build monthly readouts that move the conversation beyond vanity metrics.

**Key Requirements**
====================

* Portfolio required. Please submit a link or PDF with your application showing examples of social content you have personally produced, including AI-generated work. A brief document, a portfolio site, or a curated set of live post links all work — candidates without a portfolio won't be assessed.
* 2–4 years in social media, with at least one year of strategic ownership of a brand channel (not purely scheduling/community).
* Deep cultural fluency with how Gen Z audiences consume and create on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — formats, humor, aesthetic codes, and the cadence at which trends rise and burn out.
* Demonstrable portfolio of AI-generated social content. We will look at the actual work — examples might include AI video (Kling, Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Runway), AI imagery (Midjourney, Flux), AI audio/voice (ElevenLabs), or hybrid workflows.
* Native or proficient English.
* Deep platform fluency on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — formats, algorithm behaviour, and what audiences in INTL markets actually respond to.
* Comfort with data: you can read a content performance report and tell the team what to do next.
* Hands-on experience pulling, interpreting, and acting on social data — using either platform-native analytics (TikTok Studio, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio) or third-party tools (Sprout, Dash Hudson, Brandwatch, or similar).
* Self-directed. You can take an ambiguous brief and come back with a plan, not more questions.
* Experience running social for a brand operating across multiple European markets.

**Nice to Have**
================

* **C**omfortable being on camera. A meaningful share of our content works best when filmed first-person — trying a deal, walking through an experience, reacting in real time — and willingness to record yourself for that kind of content is a plus.
* Experience leading or mentoring others, even informally.
* Experience working across multiple markets or time zones.
* A track record of being early to a platform or format that later went mainstream.
* Light motion design or visual storytelling chops.
* Background in marketplaces, e-commerce, or local services.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Our channels feel consistently alive — never quiet, never stale.
* AI-driven production lets us ship more content per week without sacrificing quality.
* Within 12 months, organic social is a measurable contributor to brand health in NA — not just a content channel.
* NA and INTL social operate as one connected function — shared standards, shared tools, no duplicated effort.

**Location & Flexibility**
==========================

* Chicago (preferred) or US remote.
*

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, AI-Native
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative, AI-Native**
===============================================

**Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance company in San Francisco.** We're rebuilding the entire business as software, on a simple bet: turning expert human judgment into compute is one of the largest transitions left to make, and a trillion-dollar industry still run 90% by hand is the place to prove it. We've grown roughly 100x in the last year and we move at that speed: on-site, in person, long days, very high standards.

**The role**
------------

This is the SDR role as it will exist in 2030. You direct AI agents, automate your own workflows, and apply human judgment exactly where the machines stall. We call it being the human in the loop for top-of-funnel growth, and Harper is one of the few places in the world actually building it.

The primary job is AI-native outbound: sourcing new business owners from enriched public data, running call and email campaigns at volume not possible 3 years ago, and converting cold contacts into real opportunities. Alongside that, you own an inbound pipeline: working a power dialer of warm leads our AI agents couldn't reach, completing intake applications live on the phone, and warming up quoted leads and transferring them to the account executive (AE) team.

The best performers here don't stay SDRs. This is a deliberate first step into a sales and go-to-market career.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run outbound at serious volume.** Cold-calls, email sequences built with our marketing team, and follow-ups. You're the first voice of Harper. Rejection is part of the rhythm.

  **Complete intake on the call.** Learn what a business does, what risk it carries, and capture everything, in minutes, not hours.

  **Build with AI, not just alongside it.** You'll use AI agents to automate your own sequencing, data entry, and reporting. Every workflow you automate becomes permanent Harper infrastructure.

  **Partner with marketing.** You're their human in the loop: feeding back what messaging lands on calls, which ad-sourced leads convert, and which segments respond.

  **Hit volume and quality targets, both.** You're measured on new leads brought in, lead conversion, completed applications, and AE transfers. You don't trade accuracy for speed or speed for accuracy.

**Who you are**
---------------

* An ambitious and personable recent grad or early-career candidate who is excited to launch a career in GTM sales.
* Excited to join the sales team at a hyper-growth AI startup disrupting the insurance industry.
* You've worked a high-volume phone role and were good at it, or you haven't, but everyone who knows you is sure you would be.
* Rejection doesn't rattle you.
* Talking to people all day energizes you. Call 50 gets the same energy as call 1.
* You reach for AI tools by instinct. When something is repetitive, your first thought is to automate it.
* You don't need hand-holding. You need a shot.

**The reality: read this before you apply**
-------------------------------------------

This is a high-volume outbound role, on-site in San Francisco, New York or Atlanta. Monday through Friday, 8am to 8pm ET, in the building with the team.

But if you're the kind of person who gets sharper as the day goes on, this is one of the fastest paths into tech sales. You'll learn an entire industry from the inside, work at an AI-native company that's actually shipping, and help define what top-of-funnel growth becomes over the next decade.

**Compensation & logistics**
----------------------------

* **Salary:** $80,000–$135,000 OTE based on experience; higher for top performers.
* **Location:** On-site, San Francisco, New York or Atlanta. Based here or willing to relocate.
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8am–8pm ET.

**Benefits**
------------

* Uber commuter benefits
* Meals provided: breakfast, lunch, and dinner
* Snacks, drinks, and coffee stocked daily
* Free gym membership
* Health, dental, and vision insurance

**Requirements**
----------------

* Fluency in fast-paced, demanding environments (new grads OK)
* Strong multitasking ability: talk, listen, and log simultaneously
* Professional, confident, and clear on the phone
* Based in San Francisco, New York or Atlanta in-office, full-time

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Insurance, fintech, or financial-services background
* Bilingual+
* SDR or BDR roles at high-volume SaaS or AI companies
* Outbound or customer-success-focused experience

**Process**
-----------

We run a tight process and move fast, because that's how we operate.

* **AI phone screen.** A live role-play sales simulation.
* **Fit and alignment call.** Who you are, what drives you, and whether Harper is the right environment for you to do the best work of your life.
* **Super day.** 3 to 4 hours on-site: case exercises, a live cold call simulation, hands-on work with the team, and a real look at what it means to build at this level. As much for you as for us.

**To apply**
------------

Send your resume and tell us about the highest-rejection stretch of work you've ever pushed through, and why you kept dialing.

Compensation Range: $80K - $135K

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. By protecting executive time, anticipating needs, organizing competing priorities, and driving follow-through, this role creates the leverage needed to focus on the highest-value work. A central part of the role is making day-to-day executive work easier by knowing what is needed before it is requested, removing friction, and creating a smooth, well-organized experience around the work.

The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and communication skills. They are comfortable operating with limited direction, quickly distinguish what is urgent from what is important, and represent executive leadership and AHEAD with professionalism and polish in every interaction.

### **Role & Responsibilities:**

**Executive partnership and prioritization**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner and primary point of contact for executive leadership, internal leaders, employees, clients, partners, and other external stakeholders.
* Develop a strong understanding of each executive’s priorities, working style, relationships, and decision-making preferences.
* Anticipate needs, identify risks, and recommend solutions before issues become urgent.
* Triage competing requests by determining what requires two or more executives’ attention, what can be delegated, and what should be deferred.
* Maintain visibility into open commitments, decisions, and follow-up items, and drive accountability through completion.

**Calendar and meeting leadership**

* Own the complex and dynamic calendars of multiple executives, balancing strategic priorities, internal operating rhythms, client and partner commitments, travel, and personal focus time.
* Protect executive time by resolving conflicts, managing tradeoffs, and ensuring that meetings have a clear purpose and the right participants.
* Prepare the relevant executive for meetings by gathering background information, briefing materials, agendas, talking points, and relevant decisions or action items.
* Capture and distribute action items as appropriate, ensuring that decisions and next steps are documented and advanced.

**Communications and information flow**

* Communicate on behalf of the executive in a tone that is clear, thoughtful, responsive, and aligned with AHEAD’s standards.
* Monitor executive inboxes and incoming requests with sound judgment, confidentiality, and an understanding of organizational context.
* When required to draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, meeting materials, and other communications in the appropriate executive’s voice.
* Provide timely updates on emerging issues, organizational developments, upcoming commitments, and decisions requiring attention.

**Travel, expenses, and logistics**

* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including air, hotel, ground transportation, itineraries, changes, and travel-related materials.
* Manage expense reporting and related approvals accurately and on time.
* Own end-to-end logistics for executive meetings, offsites, and events, including:

* + Room selection, setup, and AV or virtual platform readiness
  + Catering and refreshment orders, dietary needs, and vendor coordination
  + On-site hosting of guests, including greeting, directions, and parking or access
  + Post-meeting cleanup and room reset, stepping in personally when needed

**Special projects and executive operations**

* Create practical systems, templates, and operating rhythms that improve executive effectiveness and reduce friction.
* Partner with other Executive Assistants and cross-functional teams to coordinate coverage, improve processes, and provide consistent executive experience.
* Support preparation for senior leadership, board, advisory, and client-facing engagements as assigned.
* Handle sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

**Office Presence, Availability, and Responsiveness**

* Work in the office 4-5 days per week. An in-person presence is required when the executive(s) you support are in the office, when the office administrator needs backup coverage, as well as key meetings and events.
* Treat the role as a 24/7 executive support position, remaining available and attentive beyond standard business hours.
* Always respond promptly to time-sensitive needs.
* Anticipate what the supported executives may need before they ask.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Five or more years of experience supporting one or more C-level executives, senior executives, or equivalent leaders in a complex, fast-moving organization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume, constantly changing workload while maintaining accuracy, composure, and attention to detail.
* Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft polished executive communications.
* High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to handle confidential info

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
Assistant Community Manager (Vacancy/Compliance Focused)

**Location:** On-site | Harlem

**Reports to:** Community Manager

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $38.46 plus discretionary bonus

**Property Overview:**

Wilson Houses, part of NYCHA's PACT program, is located in East Harlem, Manhattan, and is intended to enhance the quality and affordability of housing for its residents. The development consists of a single campus with 398 residential units across three 20-story high-rise elevator buildings, each equipped with two elevators. A community center is attached to one of the buildings.

The property also includes:

* 52 surface parking spaces
* One outdoor refuse collection area
* Two basketball courts
* Open paved and landscaped areas

The property is owned by the New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) and, through a 99-year leasehold established as part of the PACT transaction, is supported by a development team consisting of Hope Community and Apex Building Group. Twin Pines Management will provide property management services, with an overall focus on community engagement, resident satisfaction, and improving the quality of life for residents.

***Role and Responsibilities Overview***

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Community Manager supports the Community Manager in daily property operations and is prepared to manage the property in the Community Manager's absence. This role focuses on leasing support, resident services, and administrative and financial accuracy at the property level.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Property Operations Support**

* Assist the Community Manager with day-to-day operations, leasing, and resident relations
* Assist with move-in/move-out processing and unit turnover coordination
* Assist with property inspections and coordination of vendor and maintenance work
* Manage the property in the Community Manager's absence, including staff direction and issue resolution

**Financial & Administrative Support**

* Support rent collection, delinquency follow-up, and resident ledger accuracy
* Assist with preparation of financial and operational reports
* Maintain accurate resident files and administrative records

**Compliance Support**

* Support compliance documentation and recertification processes in partnership with the Compliance department
* Assist in maintaining audit-ready resident files

**Resident Relations**

* Respond to resident inquiries and service requests, escalating as needed
* Support resident engagement activities and communications
* Assist in resolving resident concerns professionally and promptly

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma required; some college coursework preferred
* 1-2 years of property management or related administrative experience
* Strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills
* Familiarity with property management software preferred
* Ability to work occasional evenings/weekends as needed

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Property administration and recordkeeping
* Resident service and communication
* Basic financial/ledger accuracy
* Time management and multi-tasking
* Team collaboration

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

No direct reports; this position does not carry standing supervisory responsibility, but may direct leasing or administrative staff when managing the property in the Community Manager's absence.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL**

* **Physical Demands:** Requires extended periods of sitting and standing, computer use, and regular property walk-throughs including stairs; occasional lifting up to 25 lbs.
* **Work Environment:** On-site at the assigned property, including office, common areas, and unit interiors.
* **Travel:** Minimal; occasional travel for training.

### **Perks & Benefits**

* We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage Access to multiple medical plan options through our benefits partner, including PPO and HMO plans, allowing employees to choose coverage that best fits their needs.
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Pre-tax accounts available for eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses.
* 401(k) Retirement Plan Opportunity to contribute to a tax-advantaged retirement plan to support long-term financial planning.
* Paid Time Off & Holidays Competitive PTO program, including paid holidays, vacation, and sick time.
* Commuter Benefits Pre-tax commuter benefits available for transit and parking expenses.
* Professional Growth & Development Exposure to complex, high-impact work within affordable housing, with opportunities to grow leadership skills and deepen regulatory and operational expertise.
* Mission-Driven Work The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting affordable housing communities across New York City.
* *Benefits offerings and employee contributions may vary by plan and are subject to change.*

Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters. The firm is internationally recognized for representing Fortune 500 companies in high-stakes litigation and government-facing matters, as well as its ongoing commitment to pro bono service and diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Crowell & Moring, exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. We are committed to delivering responsive, high-quality, and professional service to our clients and to one another, while continuously elevating standards of excellence across every aspect of our work.

**Job Summary**

The Executive Assistant provides senior-level administrative, operational, and coordination support to firm leaders, including Chiefs, Managing Partners, Office Managing Partners, and other senior stakeholders. This role serves as a trusted point of contact and liaison for internal and external constituencies and supports leaders by managing complex schedules, coordinating meetings and events, preparing confidential materials, arranging travel, tracking follow-up items, and helping advance leadership priorities. The Executive Assistant works independently, anticipates needs, exercises sound judgment, and handles sensitive matters with discretion and professionalism in a fast-paced law firm environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Provides senior administrative, operational, and coordination support to assigned firm leaders, including Chiefs, Managing Partners, Office Managing Partners, and other senior stakeholders.
* Proactively manages complex calendars, schedules meetings across offices and time zones, resolves conflicts, confirms logistics, and ensures leaders are prepared for meetings and commitments.
* Serves as a trusted liaison between assigned leaders and attorneys, business professionals, clients, vendors, candidates, and other internal and external contacts, using judgment to route, escalate, or respond to matters as appropriate.
* Handles confidential and sensitive firm information with discretion, sound judgment, and careful attention to firm policies, leadership preferences, and need-to-know principles.
* Coordinates leadership meetings, office meetings, retreats, visits, special events, and related follow-up, including agendas, materials, attendance, conference rooms, technology, and catering.
* Prepares, edits, formats, and proofreads correspondence, reports, presentations, agendas, talking points, briefing materials, spreadsheets, and other documents for internal and external audiences.
* Coordinates domestic and international travel, prepares detailed itineraries, monitors changes, troubleshoots issues, and prepares, submits, and tracks travel and expense reimbursements.
* Tracks priorities, commitments, approvals, action items, and follow-up matters on behalf of assigned leaders, helping ensure deadlines are met, open items are advanced, and appropriate stakeholders are kept informed.
* Screens, prioritizes, and responds to communications as appropriate, using judgment to determine when to escalate matters or route them to the appropriate resource.
* Supports firmwide, office, department, and leadership initiatives by coordinating logistics, gathering information, preparing materials, monitoring timelines, and partnering with relevant teams under the direction of assigned leaders.
* Builds effective working relationships with leadership offices, administrative teams, legal support, conference services, business development, technology, finance, human resources, and other firm departments to deliver seamless support.
* Maintains accurate contact lists, distribution lists, files, records, and related information in accordance with firm procedures and information governance expectations; provides back-up support and performs other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong executive presence, professionalism, discretion, and judgment in supporting senior leaders and handling sensitive firm matters.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, identify priorities, exercise initiative, and follow through on assignments with limited direction.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, competing demands, and confidential matters in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to draft, edit, proofread, and format clear, accurate, and professional materials.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and related firm systems, with the ability to learn and use additional software and technology tools.
* Strong calendar, travel, meeting, and event coordination skills, including the ability to manage complex logistics across offices and time zones.
* Ability to build trust and work effectively with attorneys, business professionals, clients, vendors, visitors, and external contacts at all levels.
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail in preparing documents, communications, schedules, reports, and expense materials.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, using sound judgment to resolve routine and non-routine issues and escalate matters appropriately.
* Ability to remain composed, flexible, and service-oriented when supporting urgent requests, confidential matters, and changing leadership priorities.
* Understanding of law firm or professional services operations, including confidentiality, client service, executive support protocols, internal collaboration, and the need to exercise discretion around leadership priorities.
* Ability to work overtime hours as requested to support business needs and leadership schedules.

**Education**

A Bachelor's Degree is preferred. Equivalent

jobs.title: Design Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Design Event Coordinator**
============================

**For the detail-obsessed, solution-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of person.**

There is something pretty incredible about watching an event come to life. The transformation of a space. The energy of a team working toward a shared vision. The moment when months of planning turn into an unforgettable experience.

But behind every extraordinary event is someone making sure every detail comes together.

**That's where you come in.**

We're looking for an **Event Coordinator** who thrives on the excitement, creativity, and occasional chaos of bringing exceptional events to life. Someone who can build a flawless timeline, anticipate a challenge before it becomes a problem, and jump into the action when the moment calls for it.

This isn't a behind-the-desk kind of role. You'll be involved in every stage of execution, from coordinating the moving pieces before an event to being on-site when it all comes together. You'll work alongside talented designers, floral teams, installation crews, and vendors to turn creative visions into remarkable experiences.

If you're energized by a fast-moving environment, take personal pride in delivering exceptional results, and believe no task is beneath you when it comes to getting the job done, we'd love to meet you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own the details.** Take the lead on event logistics, timelines, layouts, vendor coordination, and all the moving pieces that make an event successful.
* **Bring the vision to life.** Partner with design, floral, and installation teams to translate creative concepts into beautifully executed events.
* **Be the go-to person.** Build strong relationships with clients and vendors, communicate proactively, and ensure everyone feels confident and informed.
* **Make things happen.** Coordinate everything from venue walkthroughs and rental orders to staffing needs, special requests, and event-day logistics.
* **Be where the action is.** Show up on-site, oversee setup, guide teams, troubleshoot challenges, and lend a hand wherever it's needed.
* **Think three steps ahead.** Anticipate obstacles, adapt when plans change, and find solutions that keep the event moving forward.
* **Keep an eye on the numbers.** Track expenses, manage purchases, reconcile event costs, and help ensure each event is as financially successful as it is memorable.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* **You're a doer.** You don't wait to be asked, and you're just as comfortable jumping into setup as you are managing a detailed production schedule.
* **You take ownership.** You follow through, hold yourself accountable, and care deeply about the quality of your work.
* **You thrive under pressure.** Tight timelines, competing priorities, and last-minute changes bring out your resourcefulness.
* **You're relentlessly organized.** Details matter to you, and you have the systems and discipline to keep multiple events moving simultaneously.
* **You're a natural collaborator.** You communicate clearly, build trust, and understand that great events require everyone working together.
* **You're flexible and adaptable.** You understand that the event calendar doesn't always follow a traditional workweek, and you're ready to be there when it matters.
* **You genuinely love hospitality.** Creating memorable experiences and exceeding expectations is what motivates you.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience coordinating events, managing logistics, or working in event production or a related field.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with vendors, managing budgets, and coordinating multiple priorities.
* Comfort using Microsoft Office and event management platforms; experience with Caterease, NOWSTA, Social Tables, or similar systems is a plus.
* Availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedules.
* Ability to be active on-site for extended periods and assist with event setup and breakdown, including lifting up to 50 pounds.

**Ready to Make It Happen?**
----------------------------

The most rewarding events don't happen by accident. They happen because passionate, talented people care enough to get every detail right.

If you're someone who finds satisfaction in a job well done, brings positive energy to a challenge, and loves being part of the team that makes the magic happen, **we want you on ours.**

**Apply today and help us create experiences worth remembering.**

Are you a high-performing sales professional with great people skills, tree-care knowledge, and the drive to grow a premium territory?

***Joshua Tree Experts*** is expanding in North Atlanta, and we're seeking a results-driven ***Sales Arborist*** to grow our business across **Woodstock, Acworth, Canton, Alpharetta, and Cumming**. Our yard is located in **Alpharetta**, providing a home base for serving these communities.

This is an opportunity to sell comprehensive tree-care solutions-not just tree removal and pruning, but also **Plant Health Care** programs that help clients protect the health and long-term value of their landscapes. You'll partner with another sales arborist serving neighboring Atlanta territories, with company-supported marketing and digital lead generation to help fuel your success.

**The Role**
------------

The Arborist Account Manager is a year-round career focused on consultative sales, territory growth, and long-term client relationships. As the face of the "Joshua Tree Experience," you'll evaluate properties, identify tree and plant health needs, and close premium service agreements.

We're looking for someone who can turn an initial tree-care inquiry into a lasting client relationship by recommending both immediate services and ongoing care.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Territory Growth: Actively prospect, generate referrals, and build new business throughout Woodstock, Acworth, Canton, Alpharetta, and Cumming. Leverage company-supported marketing campaigns and digital leads while developing your own pipeline.
* Comprehensive Tree-Care Sales: Sell tree removal, pruning, and plant health care services through a consultative, relationship-based approach.
* Plant Health Care Development: Identify opportunities for ongoing plant health care programs, educate clients on recommended services, and build recurring client relationships.
* Property AssessmentsProposals: Conduct thorough site inspections, evaluate client needs, determine accurate job costs, and deliver clear, professional proposals.
* Client Experience: Provide prompt follow-up after services, ensure client satisfaction, and generate repeat business and referrals.
* Operational Partnership: Collaborate with office staff and production crews to communicate job scopes, client expectations, and service requirements.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Model our core values: Reliable, Team Player, ImproveAdapt, and Find a Way.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4+ years of proven success in outside sales, B2C sales, or territory management - required.
* Knowledge of plant health care programs and the ability to explain and sell them effectively - required.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola is rebuilding homeowners insurance from the ground up. We own every layer of the business, we price risk with real weather data, and thousands of independent agents trust us to take care of their clients. As we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, every new policy brings an agent and a homeowner who expect fast, accurate, friendly service. That service is what keeps agents sending us business, and it is why we are hiring our first Associate Account Manager: someone who takes pride in getting the details right, learns our business from the inside, and grows into one of the people who own Sola's most important relationships.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR**
---------

* **Role:** Associate Account Manager
* **Level:** Early career, the first step on Sola's Account Management ladder
* **Team:** Account Management, reporting to Kyle Baker
* **Key focus:** Accurate, fast service on agent and policyholder accounts while you learn to own accounts yourself
* **Location:** West Midtown, Atlanta, GA

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Associate Account Manager to own the day-to-day service requests that keep our agents and policyholders happy, from updating a mailing address to uploading claims documents into our portal.

This is the job of making sure every request is handled correctly, quickly and kindly the first time. You'll be the person our Account Managers rely on to keep accounts clean and moving, and you'll learn how insurance actually works by doing it.

You're probably a year or two out of school and have spent that time in a high-volume seat, such as sales development, inside sales or customer service, where you hit daily targets and learned to stay organized under pressure. This is not a cold-calling quota role, and it is not a role where admin work is someone else's problem.

You should constantly be:

* Closing out requests accurately and on time
* Learning how policies, endorsements and claims work
* Spotting a frustrated agent or policyholder before they become an unhappy one
* Finding small ways to make our processes faster and cleaner

You'll work alongside Kyle and the rest of the Account Management team, with close contact with our claims and insurance teams, and you'll build toward owning a set of agent relationships of your own.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Agent and Policyholder service requests such as updates to payment method, mailing address, and other account changes
* Policy service requests such as mailing address updates and other basic account changes
* Basic claims portal uploads and follow-up on missing documents
* Keeping agents up to date on their production with Sola
* Timely, professional replies to agents and policyholders by phone and email
* Accurate, up-to-date account records in our systems
* Your own queue of open requests, from first touch to close
* Flagging service issues and retention risks to the Account Managers early
* Simple checklists and templates that make common requests faster
* Learning the Account Manager playbook so you're ready for the next step

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

### **Must-haves**

* A bachelor's degree and one to two years of experience in a high-volume sales or service role, such as an SDR, BDR, inside sales or customer service seat
* A strong work ethic and a track record of hitting daily or weekly targets you can talk about with real numbers
* Care for accuracy, so that repetitive admin work gets done right the first time
* Clear, warm and professional communication on the phone and in writing
* A natural instinct for building relationships and keeping customers happy
* Coachability and a real interest in growing into an Account Manager
* Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest experiments and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.

### **Strong plus**

* Coursework or a program in professional selling
* Ranking near the top of your team on activity or results
* Comfort with a CRM and tools like Google Workspace or Slack

### **Not a fit**

* You're looking for a fully remote or hybrid role
* You see admin and service work as beneath you
* You want a pure commission sales role
* You're looking for a short stop before moving on

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Base salary of $60,000 to $75,000
* 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
* Unlimited PTO
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office
* Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday

**Our Values**
--------------

* **We are a team of owners.** Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.
* **The best idea always wins.** We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.
* **Always raise the bar.** Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.
* **Customer and partner driven.** Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.
* **Results focused.** We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.
* **Ask why, stay curious.** Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $60K - $75K

jobs.title: Specialist, Business Development Representative - C_MAT
jobs.description:
Would you like to flex your "sales muscles" in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Are you ready to challenge yourself by working with some of the top sales executives at Deloitte? We are seeking candidates for our Business Development Representative (BDR) position, part of the Ecosystems & Alliances portfolio, that will interface with some of the largest, and most sophisticated companies in the industry - our Alliance partners! This is a unique opportunity. It might be the right fit for you if:
  

* You understand that you choose your attitude each day and look for the best in people and situations
* You manage the heck out of any project. Period.
* You pay attention to details. You dot your i's and cross your t's.
* You thrive in fast-paced environments. Your competitive spirit and passion for winning is off the charts. You hate to lose (while remaining a good sport).

  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
The Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with the Channel Sales Management (CSM) and Sales Executive teams assigned to an alliance and will be at the front lines of the sales process. The BDR will perform a wide variety of activities focused on managing incoming sales leads, qualifying them, and providing handoff and support to the appropriate sales team as needed throughout the sales process. The Business Development Representative will develop deep knowledge of their alliance(s), the Deloitte CSM team and alliance's sales team, and develop strong relationships with the appropriate Deloitte offering team. The role involves:
  

* Establishing contact with identified leads through multiple channels and monitoring progress
* Qualifying leads and sharing relevant marketing and/or eminence materials to develop the lead
* Providing a strong lead and hand-off to the Sales Executive team
* Partnering with the CSM to develop sales opportunities for the Sales Executives & Service Line
* Building strong cross-functional relationships with all members of the alliance team
* Staying current with alliance news, trends and hot topics
* Supporting CSM team in monitoring and sharing relevant thought leadership, client & marketplace news, and alliance materials
* Proposing ideas for alliance team to connect with clients, including customization of Deloitte eminence materials and distribution of relevant thought-leadership to key stakeholders

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Unparalleled communication skills - you can talk to anyone about anything, especially over the phone
* You're an excellent writer. You speak clearly and with persuasion
* You're self-motivated to knock it out of the park every single time, regardless who's watching
* Exceptional relationship building/relationship management skills to establish rapport, trust and confidence with alliance teams, sales teams, and clients
* Detail oriented, ability to adapt to changing environment
* Energetic, enthusiastic and organized
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management
Ability to work autonomously while being a team player  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
The Sales Center of Excellence (COE) supports Deloitte's businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working hand-in-hand with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, these sales executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 3 years' experience
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900-$147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Construction
jobs.description:
At Haskell, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a nationally recognized Top Workplace where diverse perspectives and inclusive thinking drive stronger outcomes. Whether you’re starting out, growing your expertise, or leading the way, you’ll find a culture grounded in trust, driven by excellence, and built to support your goals. Here, you’ll have the opportunity, flexibility, and sense of belonging to grow your career your way—while making a real impact.

**Scope of Position**

Assistant Project Manager I: Entry-level construction management position. On project assignment, works with Project Managers, Directors of Construction, Project Directors and Superintendents by completing assigned tasks, as part of a project team. Expected to take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through completion. Participates in management training programs and receives training in company management tools, standards, policies and procedures. Has a basic knowledge of many project management competency techniques and concepts.

APMs are expected to spend most of their time on construction sites to effectively learn and implement construction management methodologies, gain firsthand experience in construction execution, and provide optimal support to projects and project teams, ensuring successful project delivery.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Field Management, Safety, and Quality: Works with superintendent on subcontractor coordination, self-perform scopes, safety and quality management, and job site reporting and controls. Understands Haskell safety policies and communicates to subcontractors. Implements requirements of the Quality Implementation Plan (QIP). Regularly conduct site walks, observing and documenting construction activities and details, especially related to Safety, Plans / Specifications, Submittals, and RFIs. Provide detailed reports on observations to the PM and Superintendent. May be responsible for verification of proper materials and work in place.
* Document Control and Project Communications: Reviews and transmits submittals; maintains submittal control log; prepares and manages requests for information and maintains RFI log. Manages drawing updates and preparation of meeting minutes. Manages as-builts and redline drawings in field.
* Scheduling: Works with project team to update progress schedules which may include short term interval schedules. Assists in planning construction operations and sequences.
* Financial Management: Assists with the management of project budgets, costs, invoicing, change orders and cost reporting. Applies knowledge of Haskell standard project numbering, cost codes and cost types to develop detailed budgets from project estimates.
* Procurement and Commitments: Identifies and qualifies subcontractors and vendors for assigned scopes of work. Prepares and transmits bid packages and invitations to bid. Receives and analyzes received bids. In conjunction with project manager, may negotiate, draft and award subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Estimating: Prepares detailed estimates and cost codes for initial cost control reporting and updates labor cost reports and summary cost reports.
* Scope and Change Management: Identifies and documents changes in scope during construction. Understanding of prime contract and subcontract terms and conditions.
* Design Coordination: Participates in design review meetings and reviews and monitors design with particular attention to scope, cost changes and constructability. May be responsible for applying for, tracking and expediting project permits. Coordinates with AE for design solutions and fixes for field identified clashes.
* Client Relations: As directed by project manager, may interact with client including correspondence, periodic reports, change order requests, submittal of pay requisitions, and response to client inquiries and directives.
* Project Lifecycle: Assists in preparation of project start-up and close-out requirements including unit cost history, operations and maintenance manuals, punch list management and agency inspections.
* Software Knowledge: Acquire certification and proficiency in utilizing advanced technologies, including but not limited to Procore, Building Connected, scheduling software, drones, cameras, measuring equipment, weather metering tools, augmented reality apps, and other relevant devices and technologies for project management, verification and documentation purposes.
* Travel as required.
* Other duties which may be assigned as needed.
* May supervise others.

**Education & Years of Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction management, or equivalent is preferred.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**Position Overview**  
Fooda is hiring a Content Marketing Manager to lead our content program and, over time, the team that produces it.

Fooda runs workplace food programs for employers and buildings, from rotating restaurant popups and delivery to catering and fully managed dining. Our buyers include HR and people leaders, workplace experience and facilities teams, corporate real estate, office managers, procurement, and building owners.

You’ll report directly to the VP of Marketing and work closely together on content strategy. Your first few months are about building a deep understanding of Fooda: our products, customers, and market, and the people across Sales and the business who know them best. During this time you’ll write, shape strategy, and work alongside our internal writers and freelance contributors.

At around 30-60 days, you’ll take on direct management of the content team: three internal writers and a group of freelance writers. From there, you’ll own the editorial calendar and lead the team in producing content that generates demand, equips Sales, and builds Fooda’s authority in the market.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Learn the business:

* Build a working knowledge of Fooda’s products, customers, prospects, and competitors.
* Spend regular time with Sales, account management, operations, and leadership to understand what our buyers care about and why they choose us.
* Learn what each of our audiences is trying to solve, from HR leaders to building owners, and what information helps them make a decision.
* Follow trends in the workplace, employee experience, and corporate food, and identify where Fooda has something worth saying.
* Find strong content ideas in sales calls, customer conversations, and internal discussions rather than waiting for them to be handed to you.

Shape and lead the content program:

* Work directly with the VP of Marketing on content strategy, and turn that strategy into a clear plan.
* Own Fooda’s editorial calendar.
* Lead demand generation and sales enablement content first: guides, research, webinars, customer stories, product content, and the materials Sales uses with prospects and customers.
* Develop thought leadership that builds Fooda’s authority with our buyers.
* Guide SEO and blog content as a focused part of the program, grounded in search intent and how buyers find answers, including AI search.
* Write important pieces yourself, especially in your first six months.
* Partner with our art director and design team to bring content to life.
* Turn ideas into clear concepts, briefs, and assignments.
* Hold a high standard for everything we publish, from the strength of the idea to the final edit.

Develop the team:

* Coach writers on writing, research, product knowledge, and editorial judgment.
* Give clear feedback that helps writers improve rather than rewriting their work.
* Manage freelance writers, including briefs, quality, and deadlines.
* Help the team become more independent and better able to turn direction into strong work.
* Take on direct management of the internal writers and freelance contributors at around six months.

Turn direction into work:

* Take broad or incomplete direction and turn it into a concrete plan.
* Find the people and information you need to get it done.
* Bring recommendations, not just questions.
* Own work from the first idea through publication.

 **Requirements**

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 7+ years in B2B content marketing, including ownership of a content or editorial program.
* At least 2 years managing writers, including coaching and developing them.
* Experience managing freelancers and other external contributors.
* A track record of creating demand generation and sales enablement content that Sales actually uses.
* Excellent editorial judgment and a high standard for written work.
* Strong interviewing, research, and storytelling skills.
* The ability to learn a new business quickly and understand what a B2B audience will find useful.
* A working knowledge of SEO and AEO.
* Comfort working with executives, Sales, customers, and subject-matter experts.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.

Experience in food, hospitality, or workplace services is welcome but not required. Strong B2B content leadership matters most.

**What Will Make You Successful:**

* Curiosity. You want to understand our products, customers, and market, and you keep asking until you know why something matters.
* Judgment. You know the difference between a strong idea and an ordinary one, and between great content and content that’s simply well written.

jobs.title: Specialist, Business Development Representative - C_MAT
jobs.description:
Would you like to flex your "sales muscles" in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Are you ready to challenge yourself by working with some of the top sales executives at Deloitte? We are seeking candidates for our Business Development Representative (BDR) position, part of the Ecosystems & Alliances portfolio, that will interface with some of the largest, and most sophisticated companies in the industry - our Alliance partners! This is a unique opportunity. It might be the right fit for you if:
  

* You understand that you choose your attitude each day and look for the best in people and situations
* You manage the heck out of any project. Period.
* You pay attention to details. You dot your i's and cross your t's.
* You thrive in fast-paced environments. Your competitive spirit and passion for winning is off the charts. You hate to lose (while remaining a good sport).

  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
The Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with the Channel Sales Management (CSM) and Sales Executive teams assigned to an alliance and will be at the front lines of the sales process. The BDR will perform a wide variety of activities focused on managing incoming sales leads, qualifying them, and providing handoff and support to the appropriate sales team as needed throughout the sales process. The Business Development Representative will develop deep knowledge of their alliance(s), the Deloitte CSM team and alliance's sales team, and develop strong relationships with the appropriate Deloitte offering team. The role involves:
  

* Establishing contact with identified leads through multiple channels and monitoring progress
* Qualifying leads and sharing relevant marketing and/or eminence materials to develop the lead
* Providing a strong lead and hand-off to the Sales Executive team
* Partnering with the CSM to develop sales opportunities for the Sales Executives & Service Line
* Building strong cross-functional relationships with all members of the alliance team
* Staying current with alliance news, trends and hot topics
* Supporting CSM team in monitoring and sharing relevant thought leadership, client & marketplace news, and alliance materials
* Proposing ideas for alliance team to connect with clients, including customization of Deloitte eminence materials and distribution of relevant thought-leadership to key stakeholders

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Unparalleled communication skills - you can talk to anyone about anything, especially over the phone
* You're an excellent writer. You speak clearly and with persuasion
* You're self-motivated to knock it out of the park every single time, regardless who's watching
* Exceptional relationship building/relationship management skills to establish rapport, trust and confidence with alliance teams, sales teams, and clients
* Detail oriented, ability to adapt to changing environment
* Energetic, enthusiastic and organized
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management
Ability to work autonomously while being a team player  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
The Sales Center of Excellence (COE) supports Deloitte's businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working hand-in-hand with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, these sales executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 3 years' experience
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900-$147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

As a direct report to the Area Sales Manager, the Business Development Representative will drive the acquisition of new customers and facilitate the expansion of existing accounts within the local market. This role requires a passionate sales professional who excels in identifying and expanding opportunities proactively and cultivating strong, enduring relationships with customers. This role will develop a deep understanding of TrueBlue’s offerings and how we solve customer problems.

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. .

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.
